# Source Register

One row per source item, including items confirmed as unavailable. Rows are appended at ingest (P0.S03–P0.S05) and never edited afterward; corrections are new rows that reference the row they supersede.

**Integrity:** every file listed here is covered by `00_source/MANIFEST.sha256`, generated by `scripts/p0_build_manifest.sh`.

## Field definitions

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| ID | `SRC-NNN`, assigned in order of ingest |
| Path | Location under `00_source/`; filename exactly as received. `—` for unavailable items |
| Category | `instrument` · `data` · `report` |
| Content | What the item contains (e.g., structured responses, open-ended responses) |
| Format | File type and version if known (e.g., `.xlsx`) |
| Size | Bytes, from the file system |
| Extent | Sheets, rows × columns, or pages, from inspection |
| Origin | Who supplied it and how |
| Received | Date received (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| Status | `ingested` · `MISSING` · `withheld (S8)` |
| Identity scan | `n/a` · `clear` · `flagged → <decision>` |
| Known gaps / notes | Truncation, encoding issues, anything observed but not altered |
